Most of the people giving this game a thumbs-up probably don't even play it anymore. A lot of the positive opinions seem to come from nostalgia or a few flashy gameplay moments. But if you actually play the game seriously, you quickly realize how many frustrating mechanics it has.

Here are just a few examples:

* **Advanced-tech wars:** The moment you reach the advanced tech era, suddenly BARBAR TANKS or BARBAR SAM launchers start spawning out of literally nowhere. No warning, no reasonable explanation — they just appear because the game wants to punish you. You can be rich, powerful, and well-prepared, and the game basically says: *"Oh, you're doing well? Let's make your gameplay poor and bad because we can."*

* **DLC multiplayer:** The game is so badly designed that if YOU own a DLC but your friend doesn't, your friend can't properly join/play with you. It's basically the game saying: *"Your friend doesn't have the DLC? Too bad. Go play something else with your broke buddy."* 

So yeah, nostalgia can make people remember this game fondly, but nostalgia doesn't magically make bad mechanics good.

If you're looking for a strategy game, there are plenty of better options. **Don't play this just because people remember it fondly.**
